name: Harmonica
description: Monophonic root in → chord MIDI out

sections.heading: Faders
items: Main — Chord type (Unison · Power · Min · Maj · Sus4 · Min7 · Dom7 · Maj7 · Min9 · Add9)

sections.heading: Buttons
items: Short (no fader move) — Mute / unmute all voices

sections.heading: Params / LEDs
items: I/O: MIDI→MIDI · MIDI→CV · CV→MIDI; MIDI In/Out CH
CV Gate: Sustain · ms · clock divisions
Strum (ms), Color, Range, V/Oct, Bypass quantizer
Near-0V CV = rest; unpatched stays silent until stable pitch
LEDs: IR→UV spectrum per layer; mute = red; preset flash on Alt+Long

channels.jackDescription: MIDI or CV root in; up to four MIDI chord voices out (MIDI→CV follows highest)
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Steps 0–2 = root / 1st / 2nd inversion; step 3 = open top
channels.fnDescription: Short mute; Alt+Short harmony octave; Alt+Long voicing preset
